title: Your car warranty expires today
scenario: A robocall says your vehicle's extended warranty expires today and a representative can lock in your current rate if you press 1 now.

answers.A: Press 1 and give your VIN and payment details to lock in the rate.
answers.B: Hang up. If your car actually has a warranty, it's with the dealer or manufacturer, and you can check without this call.
answers.C: Ask the caller to send an email first, then decide later.

explanation: Extended-warranty robocalls are a decades-old numbers game - they call this exact line to everyone, whether or not you own a car with an active warranty.
proTip: A real warranty renewal doesn't need to be locked in during a cold call.
